nodes.label: ATLAS Backend Report
nodes.rationale: Explains the ATLAS backend from commit 3c6abb7 on deploy/cicd: FastAPI in apps/api (~9400 lines, 74 HTTP endpoints) and the Node proxy in apps/web-server, covering CQA and Data Studio with live API examples generated 7 November 2026.

nodes.label: ATLAS Backend
nodes.rationale: One Python process (FastAPI, Pydantic v2, pandas, scikit-learn) that stores everything as files on local disk with no database. Serves CQA and Data Studio on a shared foundation.

nodes.label: Node Web Server apps/web-server
nodes.rationale: Dependency-free Node server that serves apps/web and forwards /api/* to FastAPI so the browser talks to one origin. Public boundary behind Cloudflare: decides which API paths the internet can reach.

nodes.label: Conversation Quality Analytics (CQA)
nodes.rationale: The deployed product area. Imports call-centre conversations in Russian, Kazakh and English, evaluates them against a versioned checklist through a pluggable evaluator, scores with a deterministic engine, and handles appeals with an audit trail.

nodes.label: Data Studio
nodes.rationale: Local-first analysis workbench (datasets, profiling, charts, recipes, models, findings). By default the public web server does not forward these endpoints.

nodes.label: create_app Factory and Lifespan
nodes.rationale: app/main.py builds FastAPI, registers middleware/error handlers/routers, and in lifespan creates Workspace, DatasetService, ExperimentManager, ReportStore and CqaService on app.state. Shutdown stops both thread pools and cancels queued work.

nodes.label: Workspace File Storage
nodes.rationale: Owns every Data Studio path under ATLAS_DATA_DIR. Writes are atomic (temp file then os.replace). LRU cache of up to 4 loaded tables keyed by dataset id and mtime.

nodes.label: CqaStore
nodes.rationale: JSON persistence under cqa/. Loads all JSON into memory at start-up and write-through on change. Corrupt files are skipped, never silently rewritten. Conversation files use an 8-character hash suffix to avoid case-insensitive collisions.

nodes.label: ExperimentManager
nodes.rationale: 2-thread pool that trains models in the background. Interrupted trainings are marked failed on restart.

nodes.label: Request Middleware Stack
nodes.rationale: Middleware runs in reverse add order: TrustedHost → CORS → OriginGuard → GZip (>2 KB) → thin Pydantic route → service. Routes stay thin so logic can be tested without HTTP via create_app(Settings(data_dir=<temp>)).

nodes.label: OriginGuard
nodes.rationale: Refuses POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE whose Origin is neither an allowed web origin nor the API itself. Requests without Origin (curl, tests) are allowed. Complements CORS, which cannot stop form POSTs.

nodes.label: File-Based Storage No Database
nodes.rationale: Everything is files on local disk; CQA keeps conversations, evaluations and appeals in memory. Fine for hackathon volumes, not millions.

nodes.label: No Login Authentication
nodes.rationale: Deliberate non-goal for a localhost tool. Exposure is controlled only by the web server allow-list and API_READ_ONLY. Defends against a malicious page in the same browser, not remote identity.

nodes.label: Single Uvicorn Worker
nodes.rationale: One worker is required: the CQA store and both thread pools live in process memory, so several processes would each hold their own diverging copy.

nodes.label: Evaluator Contract cqa-eval/1
nodes.rationale: Single seam between the backend and any AI model. Model receives EvaluationRequest and must return ModelOutput. Strict validation lists every problem; claimed raw_score is stored for comparison but never used.

nodes.label: EvaluatorAdapter
nodes.rationale: Turns EvaluationRequest into ModelOutput and never scores. Every module in app/cqa/adapters/ is imported at start-up; a broken adapter is logged and skipped. Team models subclass EvaluatorAdapter and register_adapter.

nodes.label: Mock Evaluator Adapter
nodes.rationale: Development only, not AI. Answers from SHA-256 of (conversation, criterion, definition); evidence is a real transcript line. Explanations start with [DEV MOCK]; overview counts mock_results. Default ATLAS_CQA_EVALUATOR=mock.

nodes.label: HTTP Evaluator Adapter
nodes.rationale: POSTs EvaluationRequest JSON to ATLAS_CQA_EVALUATOR_URL (8 MB, 180 s). Only loopback hosts (localhost, 127.0.0.1, ::1, host.docker.internal) unless ATLAS_CQA_EVALUATOR_ALLOW_REMOTE=true, so transcripts never leave the machine by accident.

nodes.label: Team Model In-Process Adapter
nodes.rationale: Documented pattern: apps/api/app/cqa/adapters/team_model.py with @register_adapter("team-model"). Selected via ATLAS_CQA_EVALUATOR=team-model or per-request adapter field.

nodes.label: Model Service POST cqa-eval/1
nodes.rationale: Outbound CQA call: POST the contract request to a local model service (example ATLAS_CQA_EVALUATOR_URL=http://127.0.0.1:9000/evaluate). One of only three outbound network calls the backend makes.

nodes.label: CQA Scoring Engine
nodes.rationale: compute_score is a pure function using Fraction so the same answers always give the same score. Only place a score is computed. N/A weight redistributed; severe_error_policy flag_only or zero_total; rounding once at the end.

nodes.label: CQA Evaluation Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Separates three jobs often mixed: evaluator only answers; contract checks answers strictly; scoring engine turns answers into points. Appeals change the final score only through new answers, never by editing numbers.

nodes.label: Evaluation State Machine
nodes.rationale: pending → running → completed|failed. After restart, pending is re-queued and running is failed as interrupted. Queue snapshots checklist version and transcript hash.

nodes.label: Versioned Checklist
nodes.rationale: Sections and up to 60 criteria with weight, answer type (binary/scale/options), N/A and severe-error rules. Criteria/sections/scoring changes save a new immutable version; evaluations store a full copy. Optimistic concurrency via base_version (409 stale_checklist).

nodes.label: Development Sample Checklist
nodes.rationale: Unofficial placeholder created by POST /cqa/checklists/dev-sample. Must be replaced by the official checklist. Scores from it are not real quality results.

nodes.label: CQA Conversation Ingestion
nodes.rationale: POST /cqa/imports fetches a group server-side so the browser never sees the signed URL. source_url_for replaces only group_id. Per-record parse; nothing invented. Transcript SHA-256 detects create/unchanged/updated/source_conflict.

nodes.label: Call Recording Audio Resolver
nodes.rationale: audio_url is an organizer player page, not a file. GET /cqa/conversations/{id}/audio extracts signed MP3 from <source>/<audio> only from ATLAS_CQA_AUDIO_HOSTS. Failures return player_only.

nodes.label: Appeals and Reviewer Overrides
nodes.rationale: Override is always a new answer, never a typed-in score; engine recomputes final_score. Original vs final score both kept. Worked example: fx-ru-001 solution none→full moved 66.3 to 96.3.

nodes.label: CQA HTTP Endpoints /api/v1/cqa
nodes.rationale: 29 endpoints under /api/v1/cqa. Default public allow-list exposes all of them through the web server, including imports, evaluations, checklist edits and appeal decisions.

nodes.label: Web Server /api Proxy
nodes.rationale: Forwards allowed /api paths to API_UPSTREAM. Strips hop-by-hop headers, adds X-Forwarded-*, keeps Host unchanged so API host and origin guards still work. Rejects %2f/%5c/\ /.. path tricks with 400 bad_path.

nodes.label: API_ALLOWED_PREFIXES
nodes.rationale: Default allow-list: /api/v1/health and /api/v1/cqa/. Paths outside return 404 without reaching FastAPI, so Data Studio uploads and training are not public.

nodes.label: Contract Evidence Validation
nodes.rationale: Every non-N/A answer needs evidence or an inspected span. Quotes must occur in the cited message (case/space/quote/ellipsis insensitive); matched character range is stored for UI highlighting.

nodes.label: Analysis Plug-in Registry
nodes.rationale: @register_analysis with column_param kinds means a new analysis needs no frontend change. GET /analyses lists parameter JSON schemas.

nodes.label: compose.prod.yml Deployment
nodes.rationale: api not published to host (expose 8000); web on 127.0.0.1:3000 with Cloudflare Tunnel. host.docker.internal lets a host model service count as local for the http adapter.
